title: Family Caught Black Friday 'Shoplifting' from Target: Cops
description:
A trio of women allegedly turned shoplifting into a family affair in Flagler County, Florida on Black Friday. Police pulled a teenager aside after she was allegedly seen walking out of a Target with multiple bottles of wine stashed in her backpack. But investigators later revealed the suspect was shopping with her mom and grandma who were also allegedly stashing wine and other groceries in their bags. Officers arrested Yelena Regul, 54, and Tamara Keetley, 76, for petit theft and contributing to the delinquency of a minor. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
